title: Giuliana Rancic Shares Adorable Pics Of Her "Lil Fireman" Duke Rancic For Halloween
description:
Now this is just too cute! Giuliana Rancic took to Instagram Thursday to share some preview pics of son Duke's adorable Halloween costume. In one photo, the E! News host holds little Duke's hand as the mommy-son duo walk down the hall. The 2-year-old looks beyond precious in firefighter boots and pants with suspenders and a white tee. Duke's fireman costume is complete with a black fireman's helmet. Rancic later shared a second solo snapshot of Duke smiling while modeling his Halloween ensemble. "My lil' Fireman," she wrote on Instagram.
